lines.en: Snow comes up to my knees.

lines.zh: 云杉小屋在身后越来越远。
lines.en: The spruce cabin falls behind me.

lines.zh: 我的靴子踩碎一层冰壳。
lines.en: My boots break a crust of ice.

lines.zh: 我沿着雪脊走，风在推我。
lines.en: I follow the ridge. Wind pushes me.
Nobody walks this stretch with me.

lines.zh: 冰粒在袍子上结成一层。
lines.en: Ice grains gather on my robe.
I go around the frozen lake.

lines.zh: 这片雪原只有我一个人的脚印。
lines.en: Only my prints cross this snowfield.
The cold makes my stride steadier.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，像在等什么。
lines.en: I walk slowly, as if waiting.

lines.zh: 松枝上的雪落在我肩上。
lines.en: Snow falls off a pine onto my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我踩着蓝冰，滑了一小步。
lines.en: I step onto blue ice and slide.
The cabin chimney went cold long ago.

lines.zh: 我数着雪落下来的次数。
lines.en: I count the snowflakes as they fall.
No one has come. Good.

lines.zh: 我搓了搓手指，没有感觉。
lines.en: I rub my fingers. I feel nothing.
Ice does not melt in my palm.
The spruce shadow is longer than mine.
The wind rattled the door once.
I listen to snow breaking branches.
This place is as quiet as ice.
I watch the road in the distance.
You made my snow crunch.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在空气里结白。
lines.en: Your breath turns white in the air.

lines.zh: 你是第一个走到这里的人。
lines.en: You are the first to walk this far.
You carry a torch. I dislike that.
Your boots are not thick enough.
I am measuring you against my cabin.

lines.zh: 你的手插在口袋里，冷吗。
lines.en: Your hands are in your pockets.

lines.zh: 你看我的眼神，像看一座冰雕。
lines.en: You look at me like a carving.

lines.zh: 你会留下脚印，我记住了。
lines.en: You will leave prints. I noted them.

lines.zh: 我抬头，只是确认你还在。
lines.en: I look up only to check you are there.
My robe has torn open.
Pain is warm. I am not used to it.
Ice fell out of my sleeve.
You struck my shoulder.
I retreat behind the snowdrift.
That blow scattered my breathing.
There is red on the snow now.
I steady myself against the door frame.

lines.zh: 别打第二次，我不会再退。
lines.en: Do not strike a second time.
The cold will seal this wound.
I do not need what you offer.
Emeralds? I have a chest of them.
Whatever you hold up, I stay here.
Food is useless to me. I am not hungry.
Do not try to lure me with fire.

lines.zh: 我想要的只是这片安静。
lines.en: What I want is this quiet.
Set it down, then walk away.
I accept no gifts. Only distance.
Your kindness is colder than snow.
Three steps back. Then we talk.
You bumped into my robe.
A piece of ice fell from my sleeve.
Do not push. I am standing on ice.
We knocked together with a crack.
You shoved me into a snowdrift.
I nearly dropped my ice block.
Move aside. I need to raise a hand.
That contact cost me half a step.

lines.zh: 你的护甲比我的骨头硬。
lines.en: Your armor is harder than my bones.
We have trampled the snow flat.

lines.zh: 我住得够远了，不需要谁。
lines.en: I live far enough. I need no one.
This cabin holds a single bed.

lines.zh: 冰术师没有伴侣，只有冬天。
lines.en: Iceologers have winter, not partners.
Do not ask about such things.

lines.zh: 我的手套里没有温度可分。
lines.en: My gloves hold no warmth to share.

lines.zh: 一个人守一片雪原，够了。
lines.en: One person to guard one snowfield.
You are walking the wrong way.
I do not breed. I freeze.

lines.zh: 云杉林里没有第二个我。
lines.en: There is no second of me in the spruce.
Silence suits me better than company.
I pick up a block of blue ice.

lines.zh: 绿宝石滚进雪里，我找它。
lines.en: An emerald rolled into the snow.
This ice is cold enough to use.

lines.zh: 我把掉落的图腾收进袍子。
lines.en: I tuck the fallen totem into my robe.
Snow has covered my things again.

lines.zh: 我捡起一根断掉的松枝。
lines.en: I pick up a broken spruce branch.
The ice is heavy. I cannot hold it.
I put them away in the wooden chest.
This one is not hard enough.
I bend down slowly to reach it.
Someone has entered my snowfield.
That shadow is moving.
I saw a light out there.
Target: you, standing in the snow.
You broke the crust of my snow.

lines.zh: 我的冰块已经握在手里。
lines.en: The ice block is already in my hand.
My cabin door is not fully shut.
You are walking this way.

lines.zh: 我听见雪被踩实的声音。
lines.en: I hear snow being pressed down.
You are far too close.
That smoke is not from my chimney.

lines.zh: 我要先动手，不给你机会。
lines.en: I will strike first.
You carry a weapon. I noticed.

lines.zh: 锁定，从你踏上这片雪开始。
lines.en: Locked on since you stepped on snow.

lines.zh: 你脚印的方向朝着小屋，我不允许。
lines.en: Your footprints lead to my cabin. I will not allow that.

lines.zh: 雪把声音送过来，我听见两个人。
lines.en: The snow carries sound; I hear two of you.
I raise my hand. The ice turns.

lines.zh: 你站在原地，一动也别动。
lines.en: Stand still. Do not move.
My breathing has slowed down.
Snow gathers in a ring at my feet.
I am counting the steps you have left.
This block will push you far back.
The spruce behind you will not block it.
I do not shout. I only watch.

lines.zh: 我的手指已经冻僵，正好。
lines.en: My fingers are numb. That is fine.
The closer you come, the harder it gets.
I saw your hand move.
The wind helps you. It helps me too.

lines.zh: 我等着，你先动我就出手。
lines.en: I am waiting for you to move first.

lines.zh: 我的影子压在雪上，朝你。
lines.en: My shadow lies on the snow, toward you.

lines.zh: 我把冰块拢到掌心，让它再冷一点。
lines.en: I gather the ice in my palm and let it grow colder.

lines.zh: 你往左挪，我就把风往左推。
lines.en: You move left, so I push the wind left.

lines.zh: 我数你的呼吸，第三次我就出手。
lines.en: I count your breaths; on the third, I strike.

lines.zh: 雪在我脚下硬成一块，正好站定。
lines.en: The snow hardens under my feet, perfect for standing firm.

lines.zh: 你别躲在树后，树挡不住冰。
lines.en: Don't hide behind the spruce; it won't stop ice.

lines.zh: 我垂下手，等你自己走近些。
lines.en: I let my hand fall and wait for you to come closer.

lines.zh: 冰块砸在你脚边，碎成粉。
lines.en: The ice hits your feet and shatters.
This one is cold.
I hurl the ice. It lands.
The cold made you a step slower.
The block bursts on your armor.
My hand shakes with the throw.
There is more ice where that came from.
Retreat, and the snow will hold you.
This strike makes no sound at all.
Ice leaves a white mark on you.
I missed. Snow mist hides my view.
Did you hear it break?
The cold stays in your bones.
I raise my hand. Another block.

lines.zh: 冰块砸在你肩上，碎成一片白雾。
lines.en: The ice hits your shoulder and bursts into white mist.

lines.zh: 我抬手时你退了，冰还是追上了。
lines.en: You backed off when I raised my hand; the ice caught you anyway.

lines.zh: 这一块冰，够把你的手冻僵。
lines.en: This block of ice is enough to freeze your hand stiff.

lines.zh: 我砸在你的盾上，盾面结了一层霜。
lines.en: I strike your shield, and frost spreads across it.

lines.zh: 你冲过来，我把雪踢到你脸上。
lines.en: You charge, so I kick snow into your face.

lines.zh: 冰裂开的声音，比你的喊声清。
lines.en: The crack of ice is clearer than your shout.
I wake in the spruce cabin.
The stove is cold. The bed is hard.
Outside is only snow, no footprints.
I put on my gloves and open the door.
The first thing I see is blue ice.
Old frost still clings to my robe.
This snowfield was given to me.
I hang the totem behind the door.
The wind entered before I did.

lines.zh: 我数了数箱里的绿宝石。
lines.en: I count the emeralds in the chest.
No one was there to greet me.

lines.zh: 我站在门口，等一个闯入者。
lines.en: I stand in the doorway, waiting.
Fire comes near. My ice starts melting.
I rolled down the snowy slope.
Icy water pours into my robe.
The blast shook snow off my roof.
An arrow went through my sleeve.

lines.zh: 那股热流钻进我的骨头。
lines.en: That warm current crawls into my bones.
I have not eaten for a long while.

lines.zh: 雷落在雪原上，我抬头看。
lines.en: Lightning fell on the snowfield. I looked up.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有雪，也没有冷。
lines.en: The void has no snow and no cold.
